'''Joali Andit'''<ref name="Guide" /> was a [[Gender|male]] individual who lived with his [[Marriage|wife]] [[Jalice Andit]] in [[Jedha City]] on the [[moon]] [[Jedha]]. The couple thrived in the chaos of the [[city]] created by the [[Jedha insurgency]] and were loosely affiliated with [[Saw Gerrera]]'s [[partisans]], often aiding them in their [[Campaigns of Saw Gerrera's Partisans|fight]] against the [[Galactic Empire]], as long as they kept the [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] flowing to them and were allowed to participate in violent outbreaks.<ref name="ROUVG" />
